```{r}
MegaAnalysisMaster <- read_sav("/Volumes/GoogleDrive/My Drive/Matthew/Mega-analysis Tech/Full Data/MegaAnalysisMaster.sav")

TechDirections_Tight <- read_sav("/Volumes/GoogleDrive/My Drive/Matthew/Mega-analysis Tech/Full Data/Tech_Directions_Tight.sav")


```

# Making Variables Factor
```{r}
MegaAnalysisMaster$Gender <- as.factor(MegaAnalysisMaster$Gender)
MegaAnalysisMaster$Has_Phone <- as.factor(MegaAnalysisMaster$Has_Phone)

MegaAnalysisMaster$Gender <- recode_factor(MegaAnalysisMaster$Gender, `0` = "Female", `1` = "Male")
MegaAnalysisMaster$Has_Phone<- recode_factor(MegaAnalysisMaster$Has_Phone, `0` = "No Phone", `1` = "Phone")

MegaAnalysisMaster$ParadigmsCombined_Factor <- recode_factor(MegaAnalysisMaster$ParadigmsCombined, `1` = "Tech Directions", `2` = "Tech Restraunt", `3` = "Waiting Alone", `4` = "Waiting Together", `5` = "Parent Study", `6` = "Lunch Study")

MegaAnalysisMasterGraphs <- subset(MegaAnalysisMaster, Gender == "Female" | Gender == "Male")

MegaAnalysisMasterGraphs <- subset(MegaAnalysisMasterGraphs, Has_Phone == "No Phone"|  Has_Phone == "Phone")


TechDirections_Tight$Gender <- as.factor(TechDirections_Tight$Gender)
TechDirections_Tight$Has_Phone <- as.factor(TechDirections_Tight$Has_Phone)
TechDirections_Tight$Gender <- recode_factor(TechDirections_Tight$Gender, `0` = "Female", `1` = "Male")
TechDirections_Tight$Has_Phone<- recode_factor(TechDirections_Tight$Has_Phone, `0` = "No Phone", `1` = "Phone")


```


```{r}
MegaAnalysisMaster <- MegaAnalysisMaster %>%
  mutate(
#Condition
    No_Phone = case_when(
      Has_Phone == "Phone" ~ 0,
      Has_Phone == "No Phone" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )
```


```{r}
MegaAnalysisMaster_TechDirections <- subset(MegaAnalysisMaster, ParadigmsCombined == 1)

MegaAnalysisMasterGraphs_WithoutTechDirections <- subset(MegaAnalysisMasterGraphs, ParadigmsCombined != 1)
```


#Checking For Outlier
```{r}
check_outliers(MegaAnalysisMaster, method = c("zscore", "mahalanobis"))
```
No outliers detected



# Emotional Valance

## Initial Model

```{r}
contrasts(MegaAnalysisMaster$ParadigmsCombined_Factor) = contr.sum(6)

EmoInitial <- lm(Emotional_Valance_Std ~Age + Has_Phone*Gender +Has_Phone*ParadigmsCombined_Factor, MegaAnalysisMaster)
summary(EmoInitial)
```



```{r}
lm.beta::lm.beta(EmoInitial)
```

```{r}
confint(EmoInitial)
```

```{r}

TechDirect.Mood_SimpEff <- emmip(TechDirect_LM.3, Has_Phone ~ Gender) 

MainMood_TechDirect_EmmeansData <- TechDirect.Mood_SimpEff$data

MainMood_TechDirect_EmmeansData$interval <- MainMood_TechDirect_EmmeansData$SE * 1.96

ggplot(MainMood_TechDirect_EmmeansData, aes(x=Has_Phone, y=yvar, fill=Has_Phone)) +
  facet_wrap(~Gender) + 
  geom_point(position=position_dodge(), stat="identity",
           colour='black') +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=yvar-interval, ymax=yvar+interval), width=.2) + theme_apa()

```


```{r}
ggsave('Mood - EMMeans - Main Model - Tech Directions.png', width = 6, height = 6) 
```


## Multi-Level Models

### Without Tech Directions
##### Model 1 - Phone Only 
```{r}
EmoVal_wo_TechDirect <- lme(Emotional_Valance_Std ~ 1 + Has_Phone ,   #Fixed effects portion of model
                        data = MegaAnalysisMasterGraphs_WithoutTechDirections, #Which data to use
                        random = ~ 1 + Has_Phone| ParadigmsCombined, #Random effects portion of model
                        method="REML", #Estimation method
                        na.action="na.omit") #missing data handling
summary(EmoVal_wo_TechDirect)
```

```{r}
tab_model(EmoVal_wo_TechDirect, digits = 3, digits.re = 5)
```

```{r}
lme.dscore(EmoVal_wo_TechDirect, MegaAnalysisMaster,type = "nlme")
```



```{r}
sigma(EmoVal_wo_TechDirect)
```

```{r}
r.squaredGLMM(EmoVal_wo_TechDirect)
```

```{r}
VarCorr(EmoVal_wo_TechDirect)
```



```{r}

intervals(EmoVal_wo_TechDirect)#, which = "fixed")
  
random.effects(EmoVal_wo_TechDirect)
```


```{r}
reghelper::ICC(EmoVal_wo_TechDirect)

ICC1.lme(SocialConnection_Std, ParadigmsCombined, data = MegaAnalysisMaster)
ICC1.lme(SocialConnection_Std, Has_Phone, data = MegaAnalysisMaster)
```

## Graphs

### Without Tech Directions
#### Violin
```{r}


ggplot(MegaAnalysisMasterGraphs_WithoutTechDirections, aes(x=Has_Phone, y=Emotional_Valance_Std, fill=Has_Phone, col=Has_Phone, na.rm=TRUE)) +
    geom_flat_violin(position = position_nudge(x = .2, y = 0), alpha = .2, adjust = 4)+
    geom_point(position=position_jitter(width = .15),size = 1, alpha = 1/3)+
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#F26627", "#325D79"))+
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("#F26627", "#325D79"))+
    guides(fill = FALSE, col = FALSE, )+ 
  facet_wrap(~Gender) + 
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = as.numeric(Has_Phone)+ 0.25, y = Emotional_Valance_Std),outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.4, width = .1, colour = "BLACK") + 
 stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_cl_normal", geom = "errorbar", width = 1/4, color = "black") + 
 stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "point",shape = 23, stroke = 1, size = 1.5,  color = "black", fill = "gold") +
  ylab('Emotional Valance Standarized by Paradigm')+ 
  xlab('Condition') + 
  theme_apa() + 
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-4,4,1))

   stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "point",shape = 23, stroke = 1, size = 15,  color = "black", fill = "gold") +
   ylab('Emotional Valance Standarized by Paradigm')+ 
   xlab('Condition') + 
  theme_apa() 
```

## Social Connectedness


```{r}
Social_Connected_Model2.1 <- lmer(SocialConnection_Std ~ Has_Phone + (1 + Has_Phone| ParadigmsCombined), MegaAnalysisMaster)

summary(Social_Connected_Model2.1)
```

```{r}
lm.beta.lmer <- function(mod) {
   b <- fixef(mod)[-1]
   sd.x <- apply(getME(mod,"X")[,-1],2,sd)
   sd.y <- sd(getME(mod,"y"))
   b*sd.x/sd.y
}
```

```{r}
lm.beta.lmer(Social_Connected_Model2.1)
```
